excerpt: Meet AI Modeler: financial models in plain language. No formulas needed.
Abacum runs AI inside your model, so every answer is consistent, reusable, and grounded in how your business actually works.
It connects ERP, CRM, HRIS, spreadsheet, and warehouse data into one governed source of truth
Interactive demo: Self-serve product walkthrough, no sales call required.
Multi-entity roll-ups with connected ERPs and normalized charts of accounts.
Connect actuals, assumptions, forecasts, and scenarios in one governed workspace—so finance can update the plan without rebuilding it.
Abacum connects pipeline, actuals and capacity in one live model. So the number you take to the board is today's, not last close's.
Actuals flow in, the narrative updates, the deck builds itself. No copy-paste between the model, the slides and the memo.
Abacum builds P&L, balance sheet and cash flow off live actuals from your ERP, so the numbers are current when someone asks and traceable when they question them.
ERP and Accounting Systems: Easily analyze your revenue, expenses, financial statements, or consolidations.
Understand and plan for each new hire by connecting your HRIS with Abacum
With group-based role assignment, Abacum lets you assign and manage user permissions easily across your workspace, all from a single, code-free interface.
you can maintain a detailed history, offering full visibility into every edit event on your data models, spaces, or dimension mappings.
Push and pull data seamlessly between Excel and Abacum, eliminating copy-paste errors and ensuring everyone's working off accurate numbers.
Budgeting and forecasting in one model: top-down targets, bottom-up inputs, live actuals.
Build base, bull and bear off the same base version. Change an assumption and watch revenue, hiring and cash move together.
Plan, approve and forecast headcount in the same connected model as your budget, so your financial model stays current as your organization changes.
Real-time consolidation of the three statements with drill-down to source data.
ERP and Accounting Systems. Easily analyze your revenue, expenses, financial statements, or consolidations.
Keep Excel in use, while leveraging the power of Abacum.
Connect your source systems, keep models and assumptions aligned, and give leaders trusted answers while decisions are still being made.

A commenter praised the launch UI, saying it shows the team has "thought through the domain to its primitives" and is well-organized, with thoughtfully organized integration toggles and data-mapping menus. They also asked how much of customer data onboarding is self-service.
Critique of the branding: "I think you may be hamstringing yourself launching a serious business product with cum in the name."
On the website's "Trusted by companies backed by these [...]" claim: "This feels a bit... underhanded. Good looking solution, though."
"This looks great! very polished look, and certainly useful." The commenter also asked what pricing looks like, which wasn't clear from the launch.

A commenter said that in previous roles, moving finance processes from Excel into something more rigid made things much more efficient. They asked how Abacum differs from Workiva or Layer, and another commenter asked how it compares with Jirav.
